title: Elige el mundo visual de Krypton
question: The roll assigned El Expediente. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: El Expediente
options.lineage: LatAm office paperwork: green-bar continuous forms, manila case files, rubber stamps, carbon copies
options.thesis: Every client process is a case file your AI agents read, stamp and close in real time, rendered as real 3D paper.
materials: carbon-blue neural fibers that read fields and route them to SUNAT, ERP, CRM
options.viewport: A real supplier invoice drops onto a green-bar sheet; neural fibers read its fields, stamps land (RECIBIDO, VALIDADO, TIMBRADO, CONTABILIZADO), headline and 'Hablar con un arquitecto' set as typed form fields beside it.
options.risk: Can read nostalgic or bureaucratic if the 3D, light and motion are not unmistakably modern.

raised.raise: Ballistics: every number and stamp moves with mass, overshoot and settle; nothing snaps to an instant value.
One gesture: a single scroll pull carries the case file through every station as one continuous spatial transition.
Palette law: each process state owns exactly one ink (red received, violet validated, green posted) and no decoration may borrow it.
Nothing disappears, it cancels: finished steps stay as stamped stubs, so the file always shows what remains.

options.label: Tejido Neural
options.lineage: Ramón y Cajal's neuron drawings rendered as a living 3D field
options.thesis: Krypton's agents are a nervous system for the company: each service is a neuron, each process a signal you watch fire.
materials: instanced 3D dendrites with depth of field
options.viewport: A dense 3D neuron field fills the screen; one signal fires from 'Factura recibida' to 'Asiento contable', headline set in the clearing.
options.risk: Also where most AI-agency sites land; glowing neural nets are the category's most familiar image.

options.label: Retratos de Datos
options.thesis: Krypton's real results become bold hand-inked graphic arguments: 99.995% as a spiral, P99 latency as slammed bars.
materials: SVG spirals that unroll into bars
options.viewport: One giant crimson spiral of uptime coils beside the headline; the CTA is a caption on the chart.
options.case: Holds product clarity (real metrics become the hero); loses audience identification with LatAm ops directors.
options.risk: Proof-heavy, so the AI-agent offer can feel secondary.

options.label: Inmersión Profunda
options.lineage: technical deep dive down a volcanic wall
options.thesis: The page descends from the agent at the surface through API, ERP, data and infrastructure to bedrock.
options.viewport: Surface light; the agent at 0 m, depth gauge on the left rail, CTA as the dive start.
options.case: Holds product clarity (the stack as depth); loses audience identification and drifts toward dark-blue category default.
options.risk: Navy depth palette sits close to every other tech site.

options.label: Puente de VU
options.thesis: Agents as channels on a bridge, needles leaning together.
options.viewport: A row of meters, one per agent.
options.case: Loses both axes: buyers don't identify with audio desks.
options.kept: True ballistics: mass and damping on every moving value.

options.label: Capa con Cordón
options.thesis: One pull transforms flat into volume.
options.viewport: Flat black plane gathered by a gold cord.
options.case: Loses both axes: fashion world, no link to operations.
options.kept: One gesture drives the whole transformation.

options.label: Billetera de Pasajes
options.thesis: Each process leg as a tear-off coupon.
options.viewport: A coupon book of process legs.
options.case: Loses both axes against El Expediente, which carries the same stamp grammar closer to the buyer's daily paperwork.

options.label: Arcade CRT
options.thesis: Agents as sprites on a tile grid.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful register undermines mission-critical trust.
options.kept: Strict palette law: each state owns one color.

canonCard.label: El estándar de la categoría
canonCard.thesis: The AI-agency standard executed impeccably: near-black, one luminous 3D orb, bento grid of services.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline over a glowing 3D sphere, logos row, bento services below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from competing AI studios by design.
